# tauri-plugin-live-activity

> A Tauri 2 plugin for iOS Live Activities (ActivityKit: the Lock Screen and the Dynamic Island; iOS 16.1+, iPadOS 17+) and Android Live Updates (Android 16+, an ongoing notification from Android 8.0, API 26). Layouts are written in TSX, TypeScript or Rust. It is built on the liveactivity-rs bridge, which runs iOS on activitykit-rs and Android on liveupdate-rs. It is a community plugin: Tauri has no official plugin for Live Activities.

In short: iOS 16.1+ and Android 8+, and no activities on desktop, where the activity commands answer `UNSUPPORTED_PLATFORM`.

Install in a Tauri 2 app: `cargo add tauri-plugin-live-activity --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml`, `npm i tauri-plugin-live-activity`, then `npx tauri-plugin-live-activity setup`, which grants the plugin's permissions, raises the Android minimum to API 26 and adds the widget extension that draws the activity to the Xcode project in `src-tauri/gen/apple`. Register the plugin with `.plugin(tauri_plugin_live_activity::init())`. No Swift or Kotlin is needed; a view of your own can still be SwiftUI.

The backend can be wrapped or replaced: `tauri_plugin_live_activity::Builder::new().layer(..)` puts a layer over the platform's backend, such as a renderer, a log or a stand-in for tests, and `.backend(..)` puts a backend of your own in its place; both use the liveactivity-rs bridge's `LiveActivityBackend` interface.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/1eedaegon/tauri-plugin-live-activity/main/README.md): what it does, supported versions, how it works, examples in TSX, React, TypeScript and Rust, questions
- [Usage](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/1eedaegon/tauri-plugin-live-activity/main/docs/usage.md): layouts, values, styles, buttons, pushes and every option
- [iOS setup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/1eedaegon/tauri-plugin-live-activity/main/docs/ios-integration.md): the widget extension, and what `setup` changes in the Xcode project
- [Android setup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/1eedaegon/tauri-plugin-live-activity/main/docs/android-integration.md): what `setup` changes in the Android project
- [OS compatibility](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/1eedaegon/tauri-plugin-live-activity/main/docs/compatibility.md): the minimum OS version of every feature
- [Permissions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/1eedaegon/tauri-plugin-live-activity/main/docs/permissions.md): the plugin's Tauri permissions

## Packages

- [crates.io](https://crates.io/crates/tauri-plugin-live-activity): the Rust crate
- [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/tauri-plugin-live-activity): the JavaScript API, the JSX layout components, React's `useLiveActivity` and the `setup` command
- [docs.rs](https://docs.rs/tauri-plugin-live-activity): the Rust API

## Optional

- [liveactivity-rs](https://github.com/1eedaegon/liveactivity-rs): the bridge, the `liveactivity` crate: the request contract, its checks and the lifecycle
- [activitykit-rs](https://github.com/1eedaegon/activitykit-rs): the iOS backend, ActivityKit through a Swift bridge
- [liveupdate-rs](https://github.com/1eedaegon/liveupdate-rs): the Android backend, Live Updates and ongoing notifications
- [Korean page](https://1eedaegon.github.io/tauri-plugin-live-activity/ko/)
